thread:
sara: heads-up — i'm trying to reconcile tenant-edge affinity with our fallback relay story. have we settled on operator-owned affinity vs customer pinning?

mike: curious — is this for Dedicated only or private too?

sara: private + dedicated. main concern: when a node fails we want graceful fallback without busting src-ip expectations.

aj: operator-owned affinity seems simpler for rollout. we can maintain an 'affinity lease' in operator-state, renew every 30s. if lease lost -> traffic flips to regional relay.

priya: question on authz: when operator flips to regional relay, do we preserve identity tokens or exchange? customer apps rely on peer cert SAN today.

sara: good point. proposal: preserve upstream cert SAN across relay by propagating original identity in a mTLS proxied header, validated at the egress bundle. that keeps app-level checks working.

frank: that sounds fragile for audited customers — forwarding identity in header needs strict signing. can we instead do a short-lived proxy cert minted by our CA on behalf of tenant?

aj: proxy cert is better for audit. operator mints ephemeral cert tied to lease, scoped to tenant, rotates on failover. fallback path uses same cert trust chain so no app change.

mike: how does this affect NAT / src-ip preservation? customers in private vpc sometimes depend on source IP for egress ACLs.

sara: we won't preserve original src-ip on regional relay. we should document that "affinity required" mode will keep src-ip, but fallback->relay will change it. customers can opt into per-tenant egress-enis if they need stable src-ip in fallback.

priya: ops question: who owns the cutover decision? operator or customer config?

aj: operator makes transient decisions (lease expiry, health probes). customer config flags whether fallback is permitted. default = allow fallback to keep availability high.

frank: rollout thought: start default-allow fallback for small tenants, alpha test with a subset of enterprise tenants who want hard affinity. need a migration path.

sara: agreed. rollout plan in short bullets:
- feature-flag per-tenant: affinity_mode = [preferred, required, disabled]
- operator maintains lease and proxy-cert lifecycle
- fallback -> regional relay with ephemeral certs if allowed
- doc page + migration checklist for tenants that rely on src-ip

mike: can you sketch the config? makes it easier for product/legal to review.

sara: quick sketch:```yaml
tenant: acme-corp
affinity_mode: preferred # required|preferred|disabled
af_handshake: operator
fall_back: relay # or per-tenant-enis
lease_ttl: 30s
```

priya: add a note that required = no automatic fallback, manual cutover only.

sara: added. also we should add metrics: lease_misses, failovers, proxy_cert_issues, srcip_changes.

devops-bot: deploy queued: feature/edge-affinity-operator -> staging (build 0.37.2) :rocket:

frank: ok let's have a 2-week alpha, ops runbook, and a short e2e test matrix (fail node, verify cert continuity, verify traffic flips).

sara: i'll open the RFC follow-up with the config + runbook + test cases. tagging @mike @aj for review when ready. :+1:
